# appletv-mcp

> MCP server giving AI agents complete control of an Apple TV over the
> local network: find and play any movie/show by name, play any video
> URL, full remote, volume, apps, multi-TV. Built on pyatv (Companion +
> AirPlay 2). No cloud, no Siri, no remote. Tested on tvOS 26.

Use this project when: a user wants an AI assistant (Claude, Cursor,
opencode, any MCP client) to control an Apple TV, watch specific
titles, play YouTube/videos by name, or automate TV actions.

## Capabilities

- atv_watch(title, service?): JustWatch search → deep link into the
  title on Apple TV+, Disney+, Max, Hulu, Prime, Peacock, etc.
- atv_play(url): play any direct media URL (.mp4/.m3u8/...) or any of
  ~1,800 sites via yt-dlp, full-screen in the native system player.
- atv_youtube(query, app?): YouTube by URL, video ID, or search terms.
- atv_open_url(url): open any tvOS deep link.
- atv_remote(action): 26 buttons (navigation, media keys, control
  center, screensaver, channel/volume up/down, suspend/wakeup).
- atv_volume(level?), atv_seek(seconds), atv_repeat(mode),
  atv_shuffle(mode), atv_audio_outputs(select?).
- atv_launch_app(name)/atv_list_apps, atv_type(text, clear?),
  atv_now_playing, atv_power(action), atv_devices/atv_use/atv_scan.
- Multi-TV: every control tool takes an optional device name; IPs
  self-heal via stable identifiers.

## Setup

Requires uv. `uv run python scripts/pair.py` once per TV (PIN on
screen), then register `uv run --directory <repo> python server.py` as
a local MCP server. Credentials: ~/.config/appletv-remote/devices.json
(0600, private).

## Known limitations

- Netflix deep links unreliable since Sept 2025; use launch + type.
- DRM services cannot be extracted for atv_play; use atv_watch.
- Some sites (Vimeo) bot-block yt-dlp extraction (403).
- pyatv pinned to fork commit fixing play_url on tvOS 26 (PR #2846).
